summary: In 10.2.0, idrac_server_config_profile can export and import custom defaults on iDRAC, and ome_configuration_compliance_baseline can schedule the remediation job and stage the reboot.
questions: Can I export custom defaults from iDRAC with Ansible?
How do I schedule compliance remediation with a staged reboot in OME?

answer_card.title: openmanage enhancements in 10.2.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_server_config_profile`: export and import custom defaults on iDRAC.
- `ome_configuration_compliance_baseline`: schedule the remediation job and stage the reboot.
